name: 01_todo
idea: A todo list app with user accounts. Users can register and log in. Each user sees only their own todos. Todos have a title, optional description, due date, priority (low/medium/high), and done/undone status. Users can create, edit, delete, and mark todos complete. Filter by status and priority.

name: 02_expense_tracker
idea: A personal expense tracker with user login. Users log expenses with amount, category (food/transport/utilities/entertainment/other), date, and notes. Dashboard shows total spent this month, breakdown by category with percentages, and a list of recent transactions. Users can edit and delete expenses. Monthly summary view.

name: 03_gym_tracker
idea: A gym workout tracker with user login. Users create workout plans containing exercises (name, sets, reps, weight in kg). They log completed workout sessions per plan. Each session records actual sets/reps/weight for each exercise. Progress view shows weight lifted over time per exercise. Users can create, edit, and delete plans and sessions.
